text_en: When the wedding celebration was ended, Tobit called his son Tobias and said to him, “My child, see to paying the wages of the man who went with you, and give him a bonus as well. ”
text_cn: 婚筵完毕，托彼特叫了他的儿子多俾亚来，对他说：“孩子，你去把工资交给与你同行的人罢！并且要多给他些作酬报。”

text_en: He replied, “Father, how much shall I pay him? It would do no harm to give him half of the possessions brought back with me.
text_cn: 他回答说：“父亲，我该给他多少工资呢？即便把他与我带回来的财产一半送给他，我也不吃亏。

text_en: For he has led me back to you safely, he cured my wife, he brought the money back with me, and he healed you. How much extra shall I give him as a bonus? ”
text_cn: 他领我平安回来，治好了我的妻子，给我索回了银子来，又医好了你。我应该给他多少工资呢？”

text_en: Tobit said, “He deserves, my child, to receive half of all that he brought back. ”
text_cn: 托彼特对他说：“孩子，他实在堪当收下他回来时，所带来的一切的一半。”

text_en: So Tobias called him and said, “Take for your wages half of all that you brought back, and farewell. ”
text_cn: 多俾亚于是叫了他来，对他说：“请你收下你回来时，所带来的财产的一半，作你的工资，然后平安回去吧！”

text_en: Then Raphael called the two of them privately and said to them, “Bless God and acknowledge him in the presence of all the living for the good things he has done for you. Bless and sing praise to his name. With fitting honor declare to all people the deeds of God. Do not be slow to acknowledge him.
text_cn: 那时，他暗地里叫了他们二人来，对他们说：“你们该赞美天主，感谢他，显扬他！该在众人前把他为你们所做的一切好事归功于他，为赞美歌颂他的圣名；该向众人隆重地宣示天主的工程，不要迟缓感谢他！

text_en: It is good to conceal the secret of a king, but to acknowledge and reveal the works of God, and with fitting honor to acknowledge him. Do good and evil will not overtake you.
text_cn: 隐藏君王的秘密固然是好， 但对天主的工程，却应该隆重地宣示和公认。你们行善，凶祸便不会临于你们。

text_en: Prayer with fasting is good, but better than both is almsgiving with righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than wealth with wrongdoing. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold.
text_cn: 祈祷与斋戒固然是善功，但秉义施舍却超过前二者；秉义而少有，胜于不义而多有；施舍救济，胜于储蓄黄金，

text_en: For almsgiving saves from death and purges away every sin. Those who give alms will enjoy a full life,
text_cn: 因为施舍救人脱免死亡，且涤除一切罪恶。施舍行义的人必享高寿；

text_en: but those who commit sin and do wrong are their own worst enemies.
text_cn: 犯罪与行不义的人，便是仇视自己的生命。

text_en: “I will now declare the whole truth to you and will conceal nothing from you. Already I have declared it to you when I said, ‘It is good to conceal the secret of a king, but to reveal with due honor the works of God. ’
text_cn: 我要向你们说出全部真情，决不向你们隐藏什么。我已经向你们说过：隐藏君王的秘密固然是好，但传扬天主的工程却是应当的。

text_en: So now when you and Sarah prayed, it was I who brought and read the record of your prayer before the glory of the Lord, and likewise whenever you would bury the dead.
text_cn: 当你和撒辣祈祷时，我便把你们的恳求呈到上主的荣耀前；当你埋葬死者时，我也同样地在你左右。

text_en: And that time when you did not hesitate to get up and leave your dinner to go and bury the dead,
text_cn: 当你毫不踌躇地起来，放下你的饮食，去埋葬那死者的时候，我便被差遣来试探你，

text_en: I was sent to you to test you. And at the same time God sent me to heal you and Sarah your daughter-in-law.
text_cn: 同时天主也派遣我来医治你和你的儿媳撒辣。

text_en: I am Raphael, one of the seven angels who stand ready and enter before the glory of the Lord. ”
text_cn: 我是辣法耳，是在上主的荣耀前，侍立往来的七位天使之一。

text_en: The two of them were shaken; they fell face down, for they were afraid.
text_cn: 二人便惊慌起来，匍匐在地，害怕得很。

text_en: But he said to them, “Do not be afraid; peace be with you. Bless God forevermore.
text_cn: 天使对他们说：“不必害怕，愿你们平安！你们该永远赞美天主。

text_en: As for me, when I was with you, I was not acting on my own will, but by the will of God. Bless him each and every day; sing his praises.
text_cn: 我与你们在一起，并不是出于我的好心，而是出于天主的圣意。因此，你们该天天赞美他，歌颂他。

text_en: Although you were watching me, I really did not eat or drink anything—but what you saw was a vision.
text_cn: 你们虽然天天见我吃喝，其实我并没有吃喝什么；你们看见的，只是个现象而已。

text_en: So now get up from the ground, and acknowledge God. See, I am ascending to him who sent me. Write down all these things that have happened to you. ” And he ascended.
text_cn: 你们现在该在世上赞美上主，感谢天主。看，我要升到遣发我来者那里去；你们该把所遇到的一切事写下来。”说完这话，便升天去了。

text_en: Then they stood up, and could see him no more.
text_cn: 当他们起来时，已经再看不见他了。

text_en: They kept blessing God and singing his praises, and they acknowledged God for these marvelous deeds of his, when an angel of God had appeared to them.
text_cn: 他们便赞美歌颂天主，并且感谢他行了这一切伟大的事业，因为天主的天使显现给他们。
